messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout started for release/v1.14.3 -> canary group A at 2026-03-19T22:00Z. CI checks green. :rocket:
releasemgr: heads up — this one has DB schema opt changes, small migration. watch canary closely.
engnancy: noted, watching metrics dashboard. will keep an eye on p50/p95 for tokenization service.
sre_ash: seeing a spike in write latency in eu-west-1 around 22:03, correlates with first canary batch. investigating.
infra-mike: I can pull logs if you want the worker traces.
sre_ash: yes pls, getting kvcache churn hints. deploying a config toggle would be our fastest rollback if needed.
deploy-bot: Deploy paused automatically by incident-monitor: anomaly_detected(rate=write_latency, region=eu-west-1) -> pause rollout. Pause reason: latency spike.
releasemgr: OK pause confirmed. Releasing hold and issuing immediate evaluation. Can we pin prod traffic to release/v1.14.2 in eu until we triage?
engnancy: we can pin at routing layer. adding `pin: release/v1.14.2` to route rules for eu-west-1.
pm_raj: tagging stakeholders and updating release notes: "hold for eu latency investigation".
sre_ash: quick triage: increased RPC contention in tokenizer shard after migration; not an obvious crash, more backlog. mitigation options: 1) rollback canary to v1.14.2 2) toggle lightweight config to disable new batching 3) increase worker concurrency.
releasemgr: prefer minimal blast radius. Option 2 first (config toggle), if no improvement within 5m then rollback canary. Can we apply toggle via feature flag?
infra-mike: yes, flag is `TOKENIZER_BATCH_V2=false` in config service. Rolling that out to canary group A now.
engnancy: applied. metrics starting to stabilize, p95 dropping from 420ms -> 180ms in 90s.
sre_ash: good sign. keep hold for full canary window (30m) and don't resume zone rollouts. re: pinning, we'll still pin prod traffic in eu to v1.14.2 until canary window completes.
releasemgr: noted. scheduling follow-up: if canary remains stable at +30m, we plan a staggered rollout to euB then global with 15m verification windows and ops on-call for 2 hours. If regressions reappear, immediate rollback to v1.14.2 and postmortem.
pm_raj: updating release notes and the changelog entry: "Rollout paused in eu-west-1 due to tokenization latency; mitigation applied, holding for extended verification".
deploy-bot: Hold recorded: release/v1.14.3 paused by releasemgr at 2026-03-19T22:05Z. Pinned route eu-west-1 -> release/v1.14.2.
releasemgr: action items: (1) eng to run a focused perf test against v1.14.3 with batching disabled, (2) infra to document feature-flag rollback steps, (3) pm to notify impacted customers if hold extends beyond 2 hours.
engnancy: working on perf harness now, will share results in 10m.
pm_raj: I'll draft a short customer note template.
sre_ash: if everything stays green we can resume canary -> euB at 22:40Z. Will post an explicit unpause.
releasemgr: thanks all. keeping this thread as the single source of truth for decisions. :white_check_mark:
